description: This file defines a ConfigHelper class within the OrangeHRM system, providing methods to retrieve, set, and delete configuration values from the database's hs_hr_config table, utilizing Doctrine DBAL for database interactions.

classes.name: ConfigHelper
classes.description: A helper class for managing configuration values stored in the 'hs_hr_config' database table, providing methods to retrieve, set, and delete configurations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor to initialize ConfigHelper with an optional database connection.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Retrieves the current database connection or initializes a new one if not set.

methods.name: getSchemaManager
methods.description: Returns the schema manager for the current database connection.

methods.name: getConfigValue
methods.description: Fetches the value of a specified configuration key from the database.

methods.name: setConfigValue
methods.description: Sets or updates the value of a specified configuration key in the database.

methods.name: deleteConfigValue
methods.description: Deletes a specified configuration key from the database and logs the operation.
